description: This file is a shell script for managing git submodules, providing commands such as add, init, update, status, set-branch, set-url, and others related to submodule management. It contains function definitions for executing subcommands and a command dispatch mechanism.

methods.name: cmd_add
methods.description: Adds a new submodule to the working tree, .gitmodules, and the index with various options like branch, force, reference, name, depth.

methods.name: cmd_foreach
methods.description: Executes a command in each checked out submodule, optionally recursive.

methods.name: cmd_deinit
methods.description: Unregisters submodules and removes their work trees.

methods.name: cmd_update
methods.description: Updates each submodule path to the correct revision, with options for fetch, rebase, re-curse, etc.

methods.name: cmd_set_branch
methods.description: Configures the default branch of a submodule.

methods.name: cmd_set_url
methods.description: Sets a new remote URL for a submodule.

methods.name: cmd_summary
methods.description: Shows a commit summary for submodules in index or working tree.

methods.name: cmd_status
methods.description: Lists all submodules, indicating their status and revisions.

methods.name: cmd_sync
methods.description: Syncs remote URLs for submodules to match .gitmodules.
